entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Congratulations on making it[n]through all your classes!

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Summer vacation's coming up[n]fast... Hope the heat hasn't been[n]too rough on you.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Since the school's closed for[n]summer vacation, we'll put my[n]counseling on hiatus for now.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: That's why today will be my last[n]day at school before break begins.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: We won't get to see each other[n]for a while, so I'd like to get in[n]one last chat while we can.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Could I have have some[n]of your time today?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: If you don't have other plans,[n]it'd be great if you could stop by.[n]I'll be around the nurse's office.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I'll be focusing on my research for[n]the whole vacation. It's strange,[n]but it could be a great opportunity.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I'll see you when school starts up[n]again. Have a great vacation!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Looks like today's your last chance to[n]see Maruki before summer vacation.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You won't be able to see him over the[n]break, so why not go check in now?
